purpose: PA30 gate 1 representative-performance sub-clause: balanced/rotated bigcherry-native vs bigcherry-serving-base

gpt_design_review.session: ses_05c3e324acd749cc (new session; prior session ses_c2892cdae7f14feb stalled again this pass, routed around per established precedent)
gpt_design_review.guidance: --pairs 2 is the documented minimum and sufficient to close gate 1's performance sub-clause per PA30's own wording (representative balanced/rotated run, not a throughput-equivalence proof -- consistent with PA26 requiring no throughput-equivalence criterion). --decision-grade / --practical-threshold-pct explicitly NOT required. hardware: Brutus, devices 0+1, dual gfx1100 (RX 7900 XTX), production-dual-xtx-shaped tensor-split config, qwen3.8-27B Q8_0
real_defect_found_and_fixed_in_this_pass: bigcherry-serving-base genuinely omits patch 0800_server_shutdown_endpoint (one of PA30's own documented 7 deliberately-removed modules vs bigcherry-native), so it has no HTTP /shutdown route. The leftover draft config from the interrupted prior pass already had shutdown_method:sigint for that arm; this pass's first two attempts incorrectly removed/misdiagnosed it (thought it was an LLAMA_SERVER_ENABLE_SHUTDOWN env omission) before confirming the real cause via config.recipes.toml resolution and restoring shutdown_method:sigint for bigcherry-serving-base only.

results.notes: tg128 (the stable metric) is effectively identical between arms. pp512's ~0.8% native-higher delta is driven by one matched low-outlier pair per arm, both occurring at schedule position 1 (consistent with the project's documented position/thermal-drift effect, which hits both arms equally in a balanced design -- not an arm effect). No material regression in either direction.

verdict: No material performance difference between bigcherry-native and bigcherry-serving-base. Representative balanced/rotated performance evidence completed per GPT's explicit guidance -- this is NOT a throughput-equivalence proof (none required by PA30 or by PA26's precedent), it is the required representative-performance evidence closing gate 1's remaining sub-clause.
